fields.mechanism: Circuit-model-based thermal analysis identifies core loss and stray load loss as dominant heat sources during no-load operation, independent of winding resistance balance.
fields.intervention: Construct an equivalent circuit model of the motor to quantify no-load core losses and verify whether lamination degradation or excessive air-gap flux density at 400 V is generating thermal energy exceeding the overload relay rating.
fields.expected_effect: Identification and mitigation of excessive core losses will reduce no-load operating temperature below the thermal overload trip threshold within the 20-minute run window.
fields.falsification_test: Run the motor uncoupled at 400 V while measuring input power with a precision wattmeter; if total no-load input power minus calculated stator copper loss (I^2 * R) is less than the thermal dissipation capacity of the frame, the core-loss mechanism is falsified.
